customers.evidence: To strive without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products

employees.evidence: To recognize the personal worth of all employees by providing an employment framework that allows personal satisfaction in work accomplished, security, advancement opportunity

community.evidence: To contribute to human welfare by application of biomedical engineering

shareholders.evidence: To make a fair profit on current operations to meet our obligations, sustain our growth, and reach our goals.

integrity.evidence: to be recognized as a company of dedication, honesty, integrity, and service

innovation.evidence: to continuously build on these areas through education and knowledge assimilation

result.analyst_notes: Formal, numbered mission-statement format, mostly in infinitive 'To...' phrasing with first-person plural 'our' and 'we'. Leads with human welfare and patients' outcomes (alleviate pain, restore health, extend life), then addresses employees and profit. Commitments are hedged or aspirational ('strive without reserve', 'to be recognized as'), not measurable. Growth-focused language appears throughout.
